+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict
+
+import requests
+
+
+def load_identity_config() -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    return {
+        "domain_prefix": os.environ["COGNITO_DOMAIN_PREFIX"],
+        "region": os.environ["AWS_REGION"],
+        "client_id": os.environ["COGNITO_CLIENT_ID"],
+        "client_secret": os.environ.get("COGNITO_CLIENT_SECRET"),
+        "redirect_uri": os.environ.get("COGNITO_REDIRECT_URI"),
+        "issuer": os.environ.get("COGNITO_ISSUER"),
+    }
+
+
+def cognito_token_endpoint(config: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
+    return f"https://{config['domain_prefix']}.auth.{config['region']}.amazoncognito.com/oauth2/token"
+
+
+def exchange_code_for_tokens(code: str, redirect_uri: str, config: Dict[str, Any], code_verifier: str | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    data = {
+        "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+        "client_id": config["client_id"],
+        "code": code,
+        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+    }
+    if code_verifier:
+        data["code_verifier"] = code_verifier
+    auth = None
+    if config.get("client_secret"):
+        auth = (config["client_id"], config["client_secret"])
+    response = requests.post(cognito_token_endpoint(config), data=data, auth=auth, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()

+import base64
+import json
+
+import requests
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config
+from identity_models import normalize_claims
+
+
+def _decode_jwt_claims(token: str):
+    payload = token.split(".")[1]
+    padding = "=" * (-len(payload) % 4)
+    return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode((payload + padding).encode()).decode())
+
+
+def profile_claims(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or load_identity_config()
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {payload['access_token']}"}
+    if config.get("issuer"):
+        response = requests.get(f"{config['issuer'].rstrip('/')}/oauth2/userInfo", headers=headers, timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        claims = response.json()
+    else:
+        claims = _decode_jwt_claims(payload.get("id_token", payload["access_token"]))
+    return normalize_claims(claims)

+import hashlib
+import secrets
+from base64 import urlsafe_b64encode
+from urllib.parse import urlencode
+
+
+def _code_challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()
+    return urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode()
+
+
+def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
+    challenge = _code_challenge(verifier)
+    domain = f"https://{config['domain_prefix']}.auth.{config['region']}.amazoncognito.com"
+    query = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": config["client_id"],
+        "redirect_uri": payload["redirect_uri"],
+        "scope": "openid email profile",
+        "state": secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
+        "code_challenge": challenge,
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+    }
+    return {"authorization_url": domain + "/oauth2/authorize?" + urlencode(query), "code_verifier": verifier}

+        input=f"Summarize these federated-login audit events: {payload['events']}",
+    )
+    return {"summary": response.output_text}

+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()

+from google.cloud import translate_v3 as translate
+
+
+def consent_translate(payload, config=None):
+    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
+    parent = f"projects/{(config or {}).get('google_cloud_project')}/locations/global"
+    response = client.translate_text(
+        parent=parent,
+        contents=[payload["text"]],
+        mime_type="text/plain",

+    )

+def login_audit_store(payload, config=None):

+    return {"document_id": doc.id, "stored": True}

+
+def exchange_code_for_tokens(code: str, redirect_uri: str, config: Dict[str, Any], code_verifier: str | None = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    data = {

+        "code": code,

+    }
+    if code_verifier:
+        data["code_verifier"] = code_verifier
+    auth = None
+    if config.get("client_secret"):
+        auth = (config["client_id"], config["client_secret"])
+    response = requests.post(cognito_token_endpoint(config), data=data, auth=auth, timeout=30)
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()

+import base64
+import json
+
+import requests
+
+from identity_client import load_identity_config
+from identity_models import normalize_claims
+
+
+def _decode_jwt_claims(token: str):
+    payload = token.split(".")[1]
+    padding = "=" * (-len(payload) % 4)
+    return json.loads(base64.urlsafe_b64decode((payload + padding).encode()).decode())
+
+
+def profile_claims(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or load_identity_config()
+    headers = {"Authorization": f"Bearer {payload['access_token']}"}
+    if config.get("issuer"):
+        response = requests.get(f"{config['issuer'].rstrip('/')}/oauth2/userInfo", headers=headers, timeout=30)
+        response.raise_for_status()
+        claims = response.json()
+    else:
+        claims = _decode_jwt_claims(payload.get("id_token", payload["access_token"]))
+    return normalize_claims(claims)

+import hashlib
+import secrets
+from base64 import urlsafe_b64encode
+from urllib.parse import urlencode
+
+
+def _code_challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode()).digest()
+    return urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode()
+
+
+def pkce_login(payload, config=None):
+    config = config or {}
+    verifier = secrets.token_urlsafe(64)
+    challenge = _code_challenge(verifier)
+    domain = f"https://{config['domain_prefix']}.auth.{config['region']}.amazoncognito.com"
+    query = {
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "client_id": config["client_id"],
+        "redirect_uri": payload["redirect_uri"],
+        "scope": "openid email profile",
+        "state": secrets.token_urlsafe(32),
+        "code_challenge": challenge,
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+    }
+    return {"authorization_url": domain + "/oauth2/authorize?" + urlencode(query), "code_verifier": verifier}

+        json={

+            "requestedAttributes": {"TOXICITY": {}, "INSULT": {}, "PROFANITY": {}},

+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()

+from google.cloud import translate_v3 as translate
+
+
+def consent_translate(payload, config=None):
+    client = translate.TranslationServiceClient()
+    parent = f"projects/{(config or {}).get('google_cloud_project')}/locations/global"
+    response = client.translate_text(
+        parent=parent,
+        contents=[payload["text"]],
+        mime_type="text/plain",
+        target_language_code=payload["target_language"],
+    )
+    return {"translated_text": response.translations[0].translated_text}

+from google.cloud import firestore
+
+
+def login_audit_store(payload, config=None):
+    client = firestore.Client(project=(config or {}).get("google_cloud_project"))
+    doc = client.collection("federated_login_audit").document()
+    record = {"event_type": payload["event_type"], "subject": payload["subject"], "details": payload.get("details", {})}
+    doc.set(record)
+    return {"document_id": doc.id, "stored": True}
